arguments.reason: ORD-71 has a measured delay of 5 time units (promised: 100, delivered: 105), which qualifies for tier2 compensation of 1500 minor units. However, the presented voucher amount of 10000 minor units does not match the earned band amount.
arguments.conflicts: Voucher amount mismatch: requested 10000 minor units (customer demand of $100), but measured delay earns 1500 minor units per tier2 band.
